This picnic shelter is available in the Tom Merrill Recreation Area.  Pavilion fee is $50 a day and shelter reservations may be made by calling (318) 949-1804, or by reserving on recreation.gov. Pavilion can hold a maximum capacity of 75 people. Located within walking distance of the comfort stations and the outlet channel.
